title: When Agent Governance Helps
abstract: arXiv:2609.05531v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05531v1 公告类型：cross（交叉）。摘要：目前尚无任何规范说明应如何设计和评估一个受治理的自主目标型AI智能体组织——即智能体在防护栏内追求自生成目标的组织。我们分两部分回答这一问题。首先，基于对321篇文献的文档式定性证据综合，我们构建了“受治理的自主目标型多智能体产品组织”框架，将能动性理论、敏捷方法、平台理论与治理理论整合为一个可运行的规范。其次，我们在CHI-Bench（一个长周期医疗保健基准测试）上，跨开源模型与前沿模型对GAMPO的提示层实例化进行了验证。结果揭示了一个边界条件：治理收益受模型剩余容量的门控，且具有领域与模型特异性。在容量受限的开源模型上，完整治理流程无法带来可靠收益，而仅一句“验证你的写入操作”的提示就能使任务成功率翻倍（pass@1从2/20提升至4/20）。在前沿模型上，同样的脚手架结构将预授权任务的性能从24%提升至……（原文截断于此）
tldr: 该研究提出GAMPO（受治理的自主目标型多智能体产品组织）框架，并通过医疗基准实验发现智能体治理的收益受模型剩余容量门控且具有领域与模型特异性——容量受限的开源模型无法从完整治理流程中获益（简单指令反而更有效），而前沿模型则能显著受益。
en_tdlr: This study proposes the GAMPO framework for governed autotelic multi-agent organizations and reveals a boundary condition: governance benefits are gated by a model's spare capacity—capacity-constrained open models gain no reliable benefit from full governance procedures (while a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles success), whereas frontier models benefit substantially.
